decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That the London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 2 February 2005 the proposed erection of single-storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse was NOT lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The volume of the proposed single-storey rear extension (47.17 cubic metres) is within the 50 cubic metres permitted development limit for the enlargement, improvement or other alteration of a terraced dwellinghouse given in given in Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 but when the volume of the existing outbuildings is added (because they would be within 5m of the proposed development) would exceed this limit.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey rear extension to existing house.
